name: inline-callout
title: Inline callout
description: Alert-based in-content callout with a tone, title, body, action buttons or links and optional dismiss. Optional labels?: Partial<InlineCalloutLabels> overrides each built-in label. Explicit content props win over labels, then I18nProvider (en/es); no provider keeps English. Imported fixtures and machine data stay unchanged. See the Catalog labels live preview.
author: gntik-ai
